description: anchors: [] MUST be rejected with schema_violation. anchors follows the absent-vs-null / absent-when-empty convention (RFC-ACDP-0002 §6.8, RFC-ACDP-0016 §4): a producer with no external anchors MUST omit the field entirely, not send an empty array. minItems: 1 on the schema enforces this — an empty array is a structural violation, not a semantically-equivalent alternative to omission.

expected.rationale: Sending anchors: [] instead of omitting the field would give a body-with-no-anchors two distinct canonical wire forms, breaking the single-canonical-form guarantee every other absent-vs-null field in the spec relies on (contrast derived_from, which is required-even-empty for historical reasons and is therefore NOT analogous — anchors is a later additive field and follows the absent-when-empty rule instead, per RFC-ACDP-0016 §4).
